personal.hobbies: In my free time, I'm interested in technology, travel and fitness. I love discovering new cultures and developing myself personally.

personal.diy_text: I enjoy repairing things at home and love being hands-on with practical work.
personal.diy_goal: Things break, that happens. Away from throwaway culture, toward recycling and upcycling.
personal.diy_useful: Sustainability and technical understanding across a wide range of topics have interested me since childhood.
personal.diy_resources: AI support | Written guides | YouTube tutorials | Consult professionals for sensitive cases
personal.action_text: I love adventures like skydiving or cliff jumping - adrenaline is my friend!
